subject: CedarCloud procurement: invoice-wave format, PO header requirements & discount lanes
messages:
From: Jane Li <jane.li@cedarcloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement requirements + PO template

Hi Soojin / Ben,

Thanks for the product walkthrough last week — CedarCloud is excited to move forward. Before legal/finance will sign, procurement needs to confirm a couple of operational items so our AP can process invoices without manual rework: 

- We require a PO number on every invoice and prefer a separate PO per billing month for large commitments.
- Our standard terms are net90; can Redwood accommodate net90 or will you need alternate terms?
- CedarCloud processes weekly invoice waves into our ERP. Is Redwood able to deliver weekly CSV invoice batches? If not, what fields would you require to map?
- Please confirm you can include a custom PO header field called "EntityCode" (we use it for entity-level GL routing).

Also, procurement is evaluating an early-pay discount if we prepay quarterly. What pricing flexibility do you have for a quarterly prepay vs monthly payment?

Attaching our PO template (CSV) to make the mapping clear.

Thanks,
Jane Li
Senior Procurement Manager
CedarCloud Inc.
Attachment: PO_template_CedarCloud_v2.csv
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jane Li <jane.li@cedarcloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement requirements + PO template

Hi Jane — really appreciate the clear list.

Short answers up front: we can support PO-based processing and custom headers (EntityCode). Weekly CSV waves are possible with some constraints; our standard is monthly billing but we can produce weekly invoice files for a pilot. Regarding net terms, our standard commercial terms are net45, but we can consider extended terms in exchange for contract-side concessions (pricing or prepay).

Proposal options we usually offer for enterprise buyers:
- Option A (preferred): Monthly invoice cadence, net45. If CedarCloud commits to 12 months >= $500k, we can add a 10% volume discount and accept net60.
- Option B (middle): Monthly invoices, net60, and a 5% discount for quarterly prepay.
- Option C (procurement-friendly): Weekly invoice waves (CSV) and net75/net90 for a 6% fee on prepaid credit or a 2% price uplift.

Operational notes:
- We can add an "EntityCode" column to our invoice CSV and map it to your PO header.
- For weekly waves, we need a stable PO ID per invoice line to avoid duplicates. If you insist on a distinct PO per month we can accept that but would convert multiple PO lines into a single monthly invoice for our internal reconciliation unless you need separate invoice numbers per PO.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Ben and I can run the scenarios with RevOps (cc Ben) to confirm finance tolerance for net60/net75.
2) If you can share the SOW milestone schedule, we can offer milestone-based early invoicing (partial invoice at onboarding milestones).
3) I'll attach a sample Redwood invoice CSV so your ERP team can validate columns.

Attachments: Redwood_invoice_sample.pdf (sample human-readable), Redwood_invoice_csv_spec.txt (CSV column list)

Best,

Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
From: Jane Li <jane.li@cedarcloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@cedarcloud.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement requirements + PO template

Soojin — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our AP team after reviewing your options:

- Net60 is more palatable than net45 for our finance leadership; net75 would require CFO signoff. Could you confirm Redwood would accept net60 for the first 12 months if we commit to the $500k minimum?
- We prefer separate invoice numbers per PO for audit reasons. If Redwood consolidates multiple PO lines into one invoice we need a crosswalk file that links invoice line -> PO number.
- For weekly waves, our ERP requires the CSV to include these fields at minimum: InvoiceNumber, InvoiceDate, PO_Number, EntityCode, LineDescription, LineAmount, TaxCode, GLAccount. Can Redwood produce that exact header?

Attached is an updated PO template and a preliminary SOW milestone schedule — please review and confirm which milestones would trigger partial invoices.

Jane
Attachment: PO_template_CedarCloud_v2.csv (updated)
Attachment: SOW_milestone_schedule_v1.docx
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: FWD: CedarCloud procurement: invoice-wave format, PO header requirements & discount lanes

Forwarding — looping in Grace from RevOps to confirm feasibility and risk.

Grace — CedarCloud is asking for: net60 (ideally), separate invoice numbers per PO, weekly CSV invoice waves with the header they specified, and the EntityCode field. They are also asking about discounts for quarterly prepay or a 12-month commitment. Soojin recommended a 10% volume discount at >= $500k + net60 as our preferred enterprise compromise.

I've attached the sample invoice and the PO template they provided. Please advise on whether net60 + 10% for the volume commit is acceptable and what the accounting uplift would be if we allowed weekly CSV waves versus monthly (operational cost).

Thanks — Ben
Attachment: Redwood_invoice_sample.pdf
(Forwarded message included below)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jane Li <jane.li@cedarcloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement requirements + PO template

Jane — happy to confirm next steps after huddling with RevOps/Finance. High level agreement we can operationalize: 

1) Commercial: Redwood will accept net60 for the first 12 months if CedarCloud signs a 12-month commitment >= $500k (deal DC-8473). We will apply a 10% volume discount in that case. If CedarCloud prefers quarterly prepay without the 12-month firm commit, we can offer a 5% discount.

2) Invoicing cadence / format: Redwood will deliver monthly invoices as our default. For a pilot (first 90 days) we will deliver weekly CSV invoice waves in the exact header you requested (InvoiceNumber, InvoiceDate, PO_Number, EntityCode, LineDescription, LineAmount, TaxCode, GLAccount). We will also produce a crosswalk file linking InvoiceNumber -> PO_Number when consolidation is needed.

3) PO mapping: We will include an "EntityCode" column in our CSV and populate it from your PO header. If you must have distinct invoice numbers per PO, we will emit a separate invoice row per PO and provide a consolidated human-readable invoice PDF as well.

4) Early/milestone invoicing: We reviewed your SOW_milestone_schedule_v1.docx and can support milestone-triggered partial invoices. Please confirm which milestones you want invoiced immediately (we recommend Onboarding 25%, Production Cutover 50%, Acceptance 25%).

5) Operational handoffs: Grace, Ben — if finance signs off on net60 + 10% volume discount, we need a short amendment for billing cadence and an attachment to the MSA defining the CSV spec and pilot period. Jane — please confirm approval from your AP/CFO so we can route through Legal.

Attachments: SOW_milestone_schedule_v1.docx, PO_template_CedarCloud_v2.csv, Redwood_invoice_sample.pdf

Next steps for CedarCloud: confirm milestone billing picks and whether you accept monthly net60 with a 12-month commit for the 10% discount, or quarterly prepay for 5%. Once you confirm we will draft the amendment and the pilot CSV spec link is here: https://redwood.box.com/s/pilot-invoice-csv-spec

Best regards,
